sources.title: Paper Report handoff protocol
sources.scope: Synthetic workflow and layout demonstration; no research result

slides.title: Paper Report
slides.purpose: 展示不绑定特定论文的公开汇报模板入口
slides.notes: 这是公开模板的封面示例。全部文字和图形均为合成教学内容，不对应任何论文、机构或个人。实际使用时应完全替换为当前论文的信息。

evidence.claim: 展示不绑定特定论文的公开汇报模板入口

slides.subtitle: A reusable workflow for evidence-backed paper discussions

slides.title: From Evidence to Slides
slides.purpose: 分开内容审校和视觉渲染
slides.notes: 章节页展示报告如何分段。这里强调内容审校和视觉渲染是两个阶段，但都由同一个 deck.json 连接。

evidence.claim: 分开内容审校和视觉渲染

slides.subtitle: Review the claims first; render the approved content second.

slides.title: One Content Source
slides.purpose: 同一内容源保持页面、备注和证据一致
slides.takeaway: One source keeps slides, notes and evidence aligned.
slides.notes: 要点页展示三个并列信息层次。实际报告中每页应只回答一个主要问题，完整解释放在备注中。

evidence.claim: 同一内容源保持页面、备注和证据一致

items.heading: Evidence
items.text: Source locations, conditions and file hashes

slides.title: Two Responsibilities
slides.purpose: 说明阅读与渲染阶段的不同职责
slides.takeaway: Approve the reasoning before polishing the layout.
slides.notes: 比较页适合呈现两个并列职责。左侧负责理解论文和核验主张，右侧负责生成可编辑页面并完成视觉检查。

evidence.claim: 说明阅读与渲染阶段的不同职责

items.heading: Paper to outline
items.text: Read the paper, verify claims and write the presentation content.

items.heading: Outline to slides
items.text: Build editable objects, render every page and review the exact candidate.

slides.title: Explain a Figure
slides.purpose: 展示单图版式及证据边界
slides.takeaway: A figure supports only the claim and conditions stated beside it.
slides.notes: 这是单图版式示例。合成图只演示版面和读图顺序，不代表任何论文机制或测量结果。

evidence.claim: 展示单图版式及证据边界

slides.caption: Synthetic process diagram for layout demonstration only.

items.heading: Show the source
items.text: Preserve labels and proportions when using a real paper figure.

items.heading: State the limit
items.text: Keep experimental conditions visible and specific.

slides.title: Compare Without Conflating
slides.purpose: 展示两图版式并区分不同图的角色
slides.takeaway: Read each chart under its own stated assumptions.
slides.notes: 两张合成图分别展示趋势和分组比较。它们没有共同实验条件，不能组合成论文结论。

evidence.locator: Bundled synthetic line and bar charts
evidence.claim: 展示两图版式并区分不同图的角色

items.heading: Trend
items.text: Describe axes, conditions and comparable points.

items.heading: Comparison
items.text: Keep groups, units and baselines explicit.

slides.caption: All values are synthetic and exist only to demonstrate the layout.

slides.title: An Editable Table
slides.purpose: 展示可编辑的原生表格
slides.takeaway: Tables remain native, editable slide objects.
slides.notes: 表格中的时间预算完全是教学示例，不来自实验。真实报告应保留指标、单位和比较条件。

evidence.claim: 展示可编辑的原生表格

slides.caption: Illustrative time budgets; not measured research results.

slides.title: Review Before Delivery
slides.purpose: 展示交付前的检查顺序
slides.takeaway: Deliver the exact candidate that passed review.
slides.notes: 流程页展示结构校验、渲染和人工视觉检查的先后关系。正式交付物必须来自已经检查的同一轮候选文件。

evidence.claim: 展示交付前的检查顺序

items.heading: Validate
items.text: Check content, notes and source assets.

items.heading: Render
items.text: Convert the candidate to PDF and page images.

items.heading: Review
items.text: Inspect every slide and revise the shared content source.
